long_biography.plain_text:
First sight of the Red Sea at about 12 turned Abdulmohsen Abdulmalik Al-Sheikh's childhood fascination with nature towards the ocean. Years of diving exposed him to reefs across the world and to the damage affecting sharks and other large predators. He began supporting marine projects, then formalised that commitment by establishing the Geneva-based Save Our Seas Foundation in 2003.

Al-Sheikh remains active with the foundation's management, but its model puts researchers, conservationists and educators at the centre. It has funded hundreds of projects internationally and built permanent research and education centres. The Academy of Underwater Arts and Sciences recognised his contribution with its 2023 NOGI Distinguished Service Award. Beyond conservation, he owns Saudi Arabia's Shgair Stud Farm, which he established to breed Arabian show horses.
